5.2.6.3 Function Elision
Using the “RTE Generation” phase API mapping, it is possible for the RTE generator
to elide the use of generated RTE functions.
[SWS_Rte_01146]
Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00051
⌈If the API mapping elides an RTE function the “RTE Generation” phase API mapping
mechanism shall ensure that the invoking component still receives a “return value” so
that no changes to the AUTOSAR software-component are necessary.⌋
In C, the elision of API calls can be achieved using a comma expression2
